title: Unit tests for GLTF print some unwanted errors
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.dev (28102e6682c7c733a23de461e30d5ae2d33fe755)
- Reproducible in 4.4.stable
- Introduced in #98909

### System information

Fedora 41, but not OS specific

### Issue description

The following errors and warnings are printed when running unit tests with `--test`:
```
ERROR: Unrecognized binary resource file: 'res://gltf_placed_in_dot_godot_imported.scn'.
   at: open (./core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:1008)
ERROR: EditorNode doesn't exist.
   at: make_scene_preview (./editor/editor_interface.cpp:236)
WARNING: 'res://gltf_placed_in_dot_godot_imported.scn': In external resource #0, invalid UID: 'uid://cpoceb3pan6fu' - using text path instead: 'res://gltf_placed_in_dot_godot_imported_material_albedo000.png'.
     at: open (./core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:1094)
ERROR: Unrecognized binary resource file: 'res://gltf_pointing_to_texture_outside_of_res_folder.scn'.
   at: open (./core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:1008)
ERROR: EditorNode doesn't exist.
   at: make_scene_preview (./editor/editor_interface.cpp:236)
WARNING: 'res://gltf_pointing_to_texture_outside_of_res_folder.scn': In external resource #0, invalid UID: 'uid://dte5b8gi8iyy2' - using text path instead: 'res://gltf_pointing_to_texture_outside_of_res_folder_material_albedo000.png'.
     at: open (./core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:1094)
ERROR: Unrecognized binary resource file: 'res://embedded_texture.scn'.
   at: open (./core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:1008)
ERROR: EditorNode doesn't exist.
   at: make_scene_preview (./editor/editor_interface.cpp:236)
WARNING: 'res://embedded_texture.scn': In external resource #0, invalid UID: 'uid://cfw4qnlsd0sx5' - using text path instead: 'res://embedded_texture_material_albedo000.png'.
     at: open (./core/io/resource_format_binary.cpp:1094)
```

The tests still succeed, but this error spam needs to be resolved anyway.

This is a follow-up to #103663 where this was discussed briefly with @demolke and @pafuent, I'm just opening an issue so we don't forget about it.

### Steps to reproduce

- Build with `tests=yes`
- Run with `--test`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

n/a
